description:
Find residential developments and new-build homes across the Czech Republic.

novostavby.ai lets you:

– Search projects, apartments and houses by location, layout, price, area and developer.
– Browse results on a map or list and open project or unit details.
– View price, area, status, amenities and other available details for any unit or project.
– See supplementary location info for selected projects, such as public transport, schools or nature nearby.
– Submit an inquiry or request a viewing directly from the conversation.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.1 requests review of the corrected housing-search integration. Server instructions use neutral wording, only present_projects declares a presentation template, and widget CSP lists exact resource origins without wildcard or connect domains. Search state persists across MCP connections within the same ChatGPT user, conversation and organization, with expiry and stale-result rejection. The map widget uses the MCP Apps host handshake and production map configuration. Search, map rendering, empty results, project details and unit details were tested in ChatGPT. The latest MCP scan has no findings.
